## v0.3.0 — OpenCode V2 Desktop compatibility

V1 plugin implementations do not run on OpenCode V2 (the loader drops them with SchemaError). The default export now carries both entrypoints from the single dist/index.js artifact.

### Added
- V2 setup(ctx) entrypoint (src/v2.ts): registers the live catalog via ctx.provider / ctx.integration / ctx.tool / ctx.command / ctx.mcp transforms plus Gemini-sanitize session hooks (context/compaction/generate, provider-scoped), TTL refresh with cleanup, and a credential-change subscription for instant post-connect pickup.
- tests/v2-compat.test.ts: 7 new tests (dual export shape, key normalization, ModelV2->Model.Info mapping, credential extraction, full setup against a stub host).
- README: V2 Desktop section (plugins object form, V1-vs-V2 mapping table, bare provider ids).

### Fixed
- Plugin loads on OpenCode V2 Desktop again (was: silently dropped, plugin list empty). Root cause: V1-only { id, server } export; V2 requires { id, setup }.

### Changed
- version 0.2.28 -> 0.3.0. @opencode/plugin >=2.0.0 added as optional peer + dev dep (^2.0.16, type-only, no new runtime dependency). V1 server() path untouched.

### Tests
- Full suite: 346 tests, 345 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped (pre-existing skip). CI green on main.

### Config
- No options-schema changes. V2 uses plugins: [{ package, options }] with the same options; provider ids are bare in V2 (no opencode- prefix gate). OMNIROUTE_API_KEY / OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL env fallback supported.
